title: Culture, values, power, and representation in AI systems
discussion_signal: The post describes research on cultural-value homogenization, culturally aligned AI in non-Western contexts, and misrepresentation in generated stories across Indic languages and regions. It supports treating identity, sacred meaning, and local red lines as design constraints rather than cosmetic localization.
linked_research_question: How do identity, sacred meaning, and local cultural red lines determine acceptable generative-AI use?
limits: Post groups several projects and does not reproduce each method
Presentation and discussion do not establish deployment outcomes
